scenarios.name: lib-01-launch-grid
scenarios.description: Folder opens to the grid; thumbnails, sizes, menus

steps.note: all nine RAWs are in the roll
cmd-minus in the grid steps the cells down
down arrow moves a whole row
a space tap in the grid ends back in the grid (hold-peek released)
Escape in the grid does nothing

scenarios.name: lib-02-loupe-cull
scenarios.description: Loupe culling with auto-advance; marks survive paging

steps.note: - in the loupe is zoom-out, not purple + advance
P on the last frame stays on it

scenarios.name: lib-03-rapid-keys
scenarios.description: Key presses at repeat speed do not skip or double-apply

steps.note: eight fast P presses advance exactly eight frames
eight fast lefts land on frame 0
eight fast rights land on frame 8
grid: eight fast lefts land on 0
grid: four fast X advance four

scenarios.name: lib-04-autoadvance-off
scenarios.description: Toggles with auto-advance off, shift forces advance, labels vs ratings

steps.note: minus in the grid = purple, no advance with auto-advance off

scenarios.name: lib-05-targets-undo
scenarios.description: Grid applies to the selection, loupe to the active frame; undo

steps.note: a decision over a multi-selection does not advance

scenarios.name: lib-06-filters
scenarios.description: Library menu filter chords, cmd-L, cmd-backslash, empty view, reject under a filter

scenarios.name: lib-07-loupe-nav
scenarios.description: Arrows pan when zoomed, cmd-arrows page, - and = ladder, E/G alternation

steps.note: zoomed: left arrow pans, does not page
the new photo opens at fit
after 10 E/G pairs we are in the grid

scenarios.name: lib-08-latency-cull
scenarios.description: Next-photo latency in cull: one step at a time, then at 16 Hz

scenarios.name: lib-09-latency-develop
scenarios.description: Next-photo latency in develop: one step at a time, then at 16 Hz

scenarios.name: lib-10-views-c-n
scenarios.description: C and N enter and leave; decisions in Compare/Survey

scenarios.name: lib-11-workspaces
scenarios.description: cmd-1..5, D R M Q from the grid, Escape layers, ctrl keys inert

scenarios.name: lib-12-panels
scenarios.description: Tab, shift-Tab, sidebar, filmstrip, column resize and its memory

steps.note: dragging the divider left widens to the 520 limit
dragging right narrows to the 320 limit

scenarios.name: lib-13-palette-reference
scenarios.description: cmd-K palette, keys while it and the reference are up

scenarios.name: lib-14-printer-keys
scenarios.description: comma/period printer-light keys: where they work and where they are dead

scenarios.name: lib-15-grid-clicks
scenarios.description: click, shift-click, cmd-click, double-click in the grid

scenarios.name: lib-16-delete-undo
scenarios.description: Delete rejects; cmd-Z walks cull steps and does not eat develop edits
